name: advisor
description: Consult an independent coding advisor at planning, recovery, and completion checkpoints.

ADVISOR_USE_APP_SETTINGS.title: Use these advisor settings
ADVISOR_USE_APP_SETTINGS.description: Choose true to use the profiles below, or false to use shared Advisor JSON configuration. Fallback permission and timeouts always come from the shared file.

ADVISOR_CLAUDE_ENABLED.title: Claude Code enabled
ADVISOR_CLAUDE_ENABLED.description: Allow the working agent to choose this advisor when these settings are enabled.

ADVISOR_CLAUDE_MODEL.title: Claude Code model
ADVISOR_CLAUDE_MODEL.description: Explicit claude- model ID supported by your signed-in CLI account.

ADVISOR_CLAUDE_EFFORT.title: Claude Code effort
ADVISOR_CLAUDE_EFFORT.description: Support depends on the model and account.

ADVISOR_CODEX_ENABLED.title: Codex CLI enabled
ADVISOR_CODEX_ENABLED.description: Allow the working agent to choose this advisor when these settings are enabled.

ADVISOR_CODEX_MODEL.title: Codex CLI model
ADVISOR_CODEX_MODEL.description: Explicit model ID supported by your signed-in CLI account.

ADVISOR_CODEX_EFFORT.title: Codex CLI effort
ADVISOR_CODEX_EFFORT.description: Support depends on the model and account.

ADVISOR_CURSOR_ENABLED.title: Cursor Agent enabled
ADVISOR_CURSOR_ENABLED.description: Allow the working agent to choose the Cursor Agent CLI when these settings are enabled. Off until you choose true.

ADVISOR_CURSOR_MODEL.title: Cursor Agent model
ADVISOR_CURSOR_MODEL.description: Catalog model id from agent models. Opus 5.5 High is claude-opus-5-5-high. The id's effort suffix must match ADVISOR_CURSOR_EFFORT.

ADVISOR_CURSOR_EFFORT.title: Cursor Agent effort
ADVISOR_CURSOR_EFFORT.description: Must match the model id suffix. Cursor Agent has no separate effort flag.
